text.en:
Item (37), on page 18, paragraph 2a, title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred is amended to read as follows:
"(37) Negros Occidental Provincial Hospital, Bacolod A-000.2a (76)
(a) Construction of Kitchen for Contagious Diseases Pavilion ₱15,000.00
(b) Construction of Laboratory Building 15,000.00"

The following item is hereby inserted on page 22, after item (62) (d), paragraph 2a, title A, section one of same Act:
"(63) Negros Occidental Emergency Hospital Himamaylan A-000.2a (80) Construction ₱25,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
